description: This source file defines a custom implementation of IFileProvider for handling module project Razor files in a development environment within OrchardCore. It manages module roots, serves directory contents, retrieves file info, and watches for file changes related to Razor pages and views.

classes.name: ModuleProjectRazorFileProvider
classes.description: A custom IFileProvider implementation that provides access to module project Razor files during development, supporting directory listing, file info retrieval, and change notifications.

methods.name: ModuleProjectRazorFileProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes module roots and page file providers based on application modules.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns directory contents for a given subpath, primarily serving 'Pages' folders within modules.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file information for a specified subpath, serving physical files if they exist.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Creates a change token to monitor file changes, supporting specific patterns like Razor pages and module assets.
